prompt: Cargo virtual workspace resolver edition 2024 opt-in
answer:
In a virtual workspace, Edition 2024 on a workspace member does **not** automatically opt in to resolver 3. You must explicitly set it in the root `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[workspace]
members = ["member"]
resolver = "3"
```

A virtual workspace has no root `[package]` section, so Cargo cannot infer the resolver from `package.edition`; the edition of a workspace member has no effect on the workspace resolver.
